description: seo-suite credit guard for paid SEO MCP tools (Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO, Similarweb, SE Ranking, Keywords Everywhere, AlsoAsked, Otterly, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Lumar) under every naming variant: mcp__<server>__*, mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__* and mcp__claude_ai_<name>__*. The matcher is case-insensitive by character classes because hook matchers are case-sensitive JavaScript regexes. PreToolUse fails closed (onFailure block); PostToolBatch has no matcher and runs after every batch in every session, so its failure must not stop unrelated work (onFailure continue); paid calls stay blocked anyway because PreToolUse fails closed. SessionStart exports the psi_api_key option as PSI_API_KEY for scripts/psi.py, and the openai, perplexity and anthropic API keys as SEO_SUITE_<VENDOR>_API_KEY for scripts/ai_probe.py (prefixed, so other tools in Bash keep their own keys). It also exports audit_profile, the four monthly budgets, per_run_cap_pct and max_rows under their CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ names, the guard's CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA as SEO_SUITE_DATA and the session id as SEO_SUITE_SESSION_ID, so scripts/audit_profile.py, scripts/rank_snapshot.py and scripts/ai_probe.py read the same budgets, ledger and per-run cap as the hooks, and scripts/claude_seo.py keeps claude-seo in the same data folder. A second PostToolUse entry on Edit|Write runs scripts/schema_hook.py, which checks JSON-LD in edited markup with schema_rules.py; it exits at once for other files, and its failure must not stop unrelated work (onFailure continue).

args:
import json, os, shlex, sys
env_file = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_ENV_FILE', '')
payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
exports = [('PSI_API_KEY', os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PSI_API_KEY', ''))]
for vendor in ('OPENAI', 'PERPLEXITY', 'ANTHROPIC'):
    exports.append(('SEO_SUITE_' + vendor + '_API_KEY', os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_' + vendor + '_API_KEY', '')))
for key in ('AUDIT_PROFILE', 'DATAFORSEO_MONTHLY_USD', 'OTHER_MONTHLY_USD', 'AHREFS_MONTHLY_UNITS', 'SEMRUSH_MONTHLY_UNITS', 'PER_RUN_CAP_PCT', 'MAX_ROWS'):
    name = 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_' + key
    exports.append((name, os.environ.get(name, '')))
exports.append(('SEO_SUITE_DATA', os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA', '')))
exports.append(('SEO_SUITE_SESSION_ID', str(payload.get('session_id') or '')))
lines = ['export ' + name + '=' + shlex.quote(value) + '\n' for name, value in exports if value]
if lines and env_file:
    with open(env_file, 'a') as handle:
        handle.writelines(lines)

hooks.statusMessage: credit-guard: checking the SEO API budget
